name: Viking Holdings Ltd

ads_ratio.source: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-03), cover page, securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b): 'Ordinary Shares, par value $0.01 per share', trading symbol VIK, New York Stock Exchange — the NYSE security is the ordinary share itself; no ADSs are registered
ads_ratio.reason: Viking is a direct-listed foreign private issuer: one NYSE-traded VIK share is one ordinary share, so no ADS conversion applies; per-share figures and the traded price are on the same basis.

overrides_applied.source: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-03), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (p. F-9): 'Investments in property, plant and equipment and intangible assets' $(1,026,854) thousand for FY2025, with $(917,424) thousand for FY2024 and $(673,932) thousand for FY2023 in the same statement
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for FY2023, FY2024 and FY2025 of the last 3 in EDGAR companyfacts under every candidate tag the engine reads (the filer's combined PP&E-and-intangibles investing line is not captured by the engine's capex tags). The engine applies this single FY2025 filing value to every missing period: against the filing's own per-year figures it overstates FY2024 capex by about $109M and FY2023 capex by about $353M, in the conservative direction (it lowers those years' OE and the median base). The line is mostly vessel growth capex, but the standardized conservative OE definition deducts total capex; the company's own split (Ongoing Capex $135,075 thousand in FY2025, 20-F non-IFRS reconciliation) is noted in analysis.md, not used to override the standardized definition.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 3.2%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-03), cover page, securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b): 'Ordinary Shares, par value $0.01 per share', trading symbol VIK, New York Stock Exchange — the NYSE security is the ordinary share itself; no ADSs are registered) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-03), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (p. F-9): 'Investments in property, plant and equipment and intangible assets' $(1,026,854) thousand for FY2025, with $(917,424) thousand for FY2024 and $(673,932) thousand for FY2023 in the same statement); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
